title_zh: 选定影迷会放映导演的首部长片

scenario.label_zh: 选定影迷会放映导演的首部长片
scenario.goal_zh: 比较熟悉影片与导演首作，并选择首作同时约定简介不预设观众看过

context_zh: 私人影迷会讨论下一次放映使用的合法可播放影片，影片和导演均为虚构。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: We've watched that cult comedy countless times. Could we choose something less familiar?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: How about the same director's debut? It is a quiet drama, not another comedy.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Would people need to know the later films to follow it?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: No. The story stands on its own. We can say it was her first feature without turning the introduction into a fan quiz.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Then let's show the debut. I'll write a short introduction that welcomes people who have never seen her work.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Good. I'll put that title on our next screening list instead of repeating the comedy.

targets.sense_zh: 受到特定群体狂热喜爱的
首次推出的作品；处女作
